summary: Fixed TOCTOU race condition in _ensure_parent_directory by changing exist_ok=False to exist_ok=True

implementation_details.root_cause: Race condition between parent.exists() check and parent.mkdir(exist_ok=False) call - another process could create the directory in between
implementation_details.fix: Changed exist_ok=False to exist_ok=True in parent.mkdir() call to gracefully handle the race condition

risks: Minimal - exist_ok=True is the standard pattern for avoiding TOCTOU race conditions
